title: Object Pool
description: Reuse objects instead of `new`/`delete` each frame (common in games).
requirements: `Pool<Bullet>` (non-template is fine: `BulletPool`) with fixed capacity of preallocated objects
`acquire()` returns a handle/pointer to a free object; `release()` returns it
Stretch: handle returned as a `unique_ptr` with a custom deleter that releases to the pool
